title: Family Safety Capability and Policy Foundation
objective: Implement the bounded Family Safety Capability and Policy Foundation tranche after completed_verified MIB-16 using the approved MIB-17 deliverables and completion gate.

scope.purpose: Prepare Multiversal-controlled child/family protections before platform-specific parental APIs exist.
deliverables: capability taxonomy for invitations, communication, community/public content, mature-content exposure, AI assistance, purchases/commerce hooks, external links and other Multiversal-controlled surfaces
guardian authority explicitly separate from GM/Campaign/private-creator authority
age-band/profile metadata without pretending to implement unavailable platform controls
test matrix for bypass/cross-context authority leakage
scope.completion_gate: Product-controlled capabilities can be deterministically policy-gated without granting guardians unintended access to private creative or Campaign-hidden content.

selection_boundaries: MIB-16 is completed_verified and its implementation authority is retired.
MIB-17 is the only authorized product-development work item for this attempt.
Platform-specific parental APIs, unavailable platform controls, paid providers and production deployment remain out of scope.
Guardian authority must not imply GM, Campaign-hidden, private-creator, canonical, mechanical or unrestricted account authority.
MIB-18 remains planned and unauthorized until MIB-17 is completed_verified and the owner continues.
next_action: Implement the approved MIB-17 capability taxonomy, guardian-policy evaluator, child-safe projection hooks, Workbench fixtures and bypass/cross-context regression matrix on the authorized application branch.
